scope: Diagonal fixed stage alpha only;144new physical plus72reused. Known DEV, not new training or alpha-planning validation

metrics: Task outcomes from runner. Ground error means use each actual ground window; paired differences use common actual duration and equal phase0/2 samples, no extrapolation after goal/failure.
